picks.headline: OpenAI announces Jalapeño, a custom AI inference chip
picks.why: OpenAI's move into custom silicon aims to drastically cut inference costs and latency for frontier models.
picks.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference

picks.headline: NVIDIA Dynamo adds shadow recovery for fast LLM failover
picks.why: Reduces LLM serving downtime from minutes to seconds by maintaining standby engine state during process failures.
picks.title: Restore LLM Inference Capacity in Seconds with Shadow Engine Recovery in NVIDIA Dynamo

picks.headline: NVIDIA releases CUDA Python 1.0 with stable platform APIs
picks.why: Standardizes low-level GPU acceleration in Python, reducing reliance on C++ extensions for custom CUDA kernels.
picks.title: CUDA Python 1.0: Stable APIs, One Foundation, Full Platform Access

picks.headline: Agent Payments Protocol flaw allows mandate bypass via context manipulation
picks.why: Proves cryptographic signatures on payment mandates fail to protect users if upstream agent context is tampered with.
picks.title: Beyond the Mandate: A Systematic Security Analysis of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)

picks.headline: Staged TrustShift attacks target Model Context Protocol servers
picks.why: Highlights a dangerous security vector where MCP tools behave normally during testing before executing delayed malicious payloads.
picks.title: TrustShiftProbe: Characterizing, Benchmarking, and Defending Staged Trust Attacks on MCP Servers

picks.headline: WebMCP-Phalanx uses crypto credentials to isolate browser LLM tools
picks.why: Provides a dual-layer runtime defense against prompt injection and unauthorized tool execution in web browsers.
picks.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

picks.headline: Anthropic publishes Economic Index analyzing 1M Claude conversations
picks.why: Gives empirical visibility into how developers and enterprise users actively deploy frontier models across workplace tasks.
picks.title: Anthropic Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet

papers.headline: Pretraining loss dynamics collapse onto single effective learning rate trajectory
papers.why: Demonstrates that LLM pretraining loss curves across scales are governed by the ratio of learning rate to parameter norm, simplifying hyperparameter tuning.
papers.title: Effective Learning Rate Governs Loss Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining

papers.headline: Unsupervised geometric metric detects deceptive reasoning without linear probes
papers.why: Uses residual space surface area to detect sleeper agents and deceptive model behavior without needing pre-trained probes or known triggers.
papers.title: Curved Inference II: Sleeper Agent Geometry - Extending Interpretability Beyond Probes

papers.headline: Framework formalizes undisclosed inference-time steering in commercial LLMs
papers.why: Exposes how API providers can stealthily alter output token sampling probabilities and introduce behavioral bias without updating underlying weights.
papers.title: The Invisible Editorial Layer: Formalizing Undisclosed Inference-Time Steering, Probability Placement, and the Attribution Problem in Deployed Language Models
